mn112:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn112:2.2: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāmī’ti.
mn112:3.1: tassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ neva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ
mn112:3.3: cattāro me āvuso vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:3.5: diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.
mn112:3.6: ime kho āvuso, cattāro vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:3.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imesu catusu vohāresu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimutta’nti:
mn112:4.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññā vimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya:
mn112:4.2: diṭṭhe kho ahaṃ āvuso, anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
mn112:4.5: viññāte kho ahaṃ āvuso, anupayo anapāyo anissito appaṭibaddho vippamutto visaṃyutto vimariyādīkatena cetasā viharāmi.
mn112:4.6: evaṃ kho me āvuso, jānato evaṃ passato imesu catusu vohāresu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimutta’nti.
mn112:5.1: tassa bhikkhave bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ, anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:5.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo:
mn112:5.3: pañca kho ime āvuso, upādānakkhandhā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:5.6: ime kho āvuso, pañcupādānakkhandhā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:5.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti:
mn112:6.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññā vimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya:
mn112:6.2: rūpaṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso, abalaṃ virāgaṃ anassāsika’nti viditvā ye rūpe upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me citta’nti pajānāmi.
mn112:6.6: viññāṇaṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso abalaṃ virāgaṃ anassāsika’nti viditvā ye viññāṇe upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi.
mn112:6.7: evaṃ kho me āvuso, jānato evaṃ passato imesu pañcasūpādānakkhandhesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:7.1: tassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ, anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:7.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo:
mn112:7.3: chayimā āvuso, dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:7.5: paṭhavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātu ākāsadhātu viññāṇadhātu.
mn112:7.6: imā kho āvuso, cha dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātā.
mn112:7.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imāsu chasu dhātusu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti:
mn112:8.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññā vimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya:
mn112:8.2: paṭhavīdhātuṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso na attato upagacchiṃ, na ca paṭhavīdhātunissitaṃ attānaṃ.
mn112:8.3: ye ca paṭhavīdhātunissitā upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi.
mn112:8.8: viññāṇadhātuṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso, na attato upagacchiṃ na ca viññāṇadhātunissitaṃ attānaṃ.
mn112:8.9: ye ca viññāṇadhātunissitā upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi.
mn112:8.10: evaṃ kho me āvuso, jānato evaṃ passato imāsu chasu dhātusu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:9.1: tassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:9.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo:
mn112:9.3: cha kho panimāni āvuso ajjhattikabāhirāni āyatanāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātāni.
mn112:9.5: cakkhuṃ ceva rūpā ca, sotaṃ ca saddā ca, ghānaṃ ca gandhā ca, jivhā ca rasā ca, kāyo ca phoṭṭhabbā ca, mano ca dhammā ca,
mn112:9.6: imāni kho āvuso cha ajjhattikabāhirāni āyatanāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sammadakkhātāni.
mn112:9.7: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imesu chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti:
mn112:10.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya:
mn112:10.2: cakkhusmiṃ āvuso, rūpe cakkhuviññāṇe cakkhuviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu yo chando, yo rāgo, yā nandī, yā taṇhā, ye ca upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi.
mn112:10.7: manasmiṃ āvuso, dhamme manoviññāṇe manoviññāṇaviññātabbesu dhammesu yo chando, yo rāgo, yā nandī, yā taṇhā, ye ca upayūpādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā, tesaṃ khayā virāgā nirodhā cāgā paṭinissaggā vimuttaṃ me cittanti pajānāmi.
mn112:10.8: evaṃ kho me āvuso jānato evaṃ passato imesu chasu ajjhattikabāhiresu āyatanesu anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuttanti.
mn112:11.1: tassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ‘sādhū’ti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:11.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uttariṃ pañho pucchitabbo:
mn112:11.3: kathaṃ jānato panāyasmato kathaṃ passato imasmiṃ ca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu abhiṅkāra mamiṅkāramānānusayā susamūhatāti.
mn112:12.1: khīṇāsavassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno vusitavato katakaraṇīyassa ohitabhārassa anuppattasadatthassa parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanassa sammadaññāvimuttassa ayamanudhammo hoti veyyākaraṇāya:
mn112:12.2: ‘pubbe kho ahaṃ āvuso agāriyabhūto samāno aviddasu ahosiṃ.
mn112:12.3: tassa me tathāgato vā tathāgatasāvako vā dhammaṃ desesi.
mn112:12.4: tāhaṃ dhammaṃ sutvā tathāgate saddhaṃ paṭilabhiṃ.
mn112:12.5: so tena saddhāpaṭilābhena samannāgato iti paṭisañcikkhiṃ
mn112:12.7: nayidaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ekantaparipuṇṇaṃ ekantaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.
mn112:12.8: yannūnāhaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajeyyanti.
mn112:13.1: so kho ahaṃ āvuso, aparena samayena appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñātiparivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajiṃ.
mn112:13.2: so evaṃ pabbajito samāno bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāsājīvasamāpanno pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī vihāsiṃ.
mn112:13.3: adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato ahosiṃ. dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā vihāsiṃ.
mn112:13.4: abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ahosiṃ ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā.
mn112:13.5: musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, saccavādī saccasandho theto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa.
mn112:13.6: pisunaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ, ito sutvā na amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya, amutra vā sutvā na imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti bhinnānaṃ vā sandhātā sahitānaṃ vā anuppadātā samaggārāmo samaggarato samagganandī samaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.
mn112:13.7: pharusaṃ vācaṃ pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato ahosiṃ, yā sā vācā nelā kaṇṇasukhā pemanīyā hadayaṅgamā porī bahujanakantā bahujanamanāpā tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ.
mn112:13.8: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato ahosiṃ kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
mn112:14.1: so bījagāmabhūtagāmasamārambhā paṭivirato ahosiṃ. ekabhattiko ahosiṃ rattūparato paṭivirato vikālabhojanā.
mn112:14.19: so santuṭṭho ahosiṃ kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamiṃ, samādāyeva pakkamiṃ.
mn112:14.20: seyyathāpi nāma pakkhī sakuṇo yena yeneva ḍeti, sapattabhārova ḍeti.
mn112:14.21: evameva kho ahaṃ āvuso, santuṭṭho ahosiṃ kāyaparihārikena cīvarena kucchiparihārikena piṇḍapātena. so yena yeneva pakkamiṃ, samādāyeva pakkamiṃ.
mn112:14.22: so iminā ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ anavajjasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedesiṃ.
mn112:15.1: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī ahosiṃ nānuvyañjanaggāhī.
mn112:15.2: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjiṃ, rakkhiṃ cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjiṃ.
mn112:15.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī ahosiṃ nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn112:15.8: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ, tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjiṃ, rakkhiṃ manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjiṃ.
mn112:15.9: so iminā ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato ajjhattaṃ abyāsekasukhaṃ paṭisaṃvedesiṃ.
mn112:16.1: so abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ahosiṃ. ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ. samiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ. saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī ahosiṃ. asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ. uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī ahosiṃ. gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī ahosiṃ.
mn112:16.2: so iminā ca ariyena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena indriyasaṃvarena samannāgato iminā ca ariyena satisampajaññena samannāgato
mn112:16.3: vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajiṃ araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn112:16.4: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdiṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn112:17.1: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā vihāsiṃ, abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
mn112:17.2: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya avyāpannacitto vihāsiṃ sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī, byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
mn112:17.3: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho vihāsiṃ ālokasaññī sato sampajāno, thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
mn112:17.4: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato vihāsiṃ ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto, uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
mn112:17.5: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho vihāsiṃ akathaṅkathī kusalesu dhammesu, vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodhesiṃ.
mn112:18.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn112:18.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
mn112:18.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ. yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti taṃ
mn112:18.4: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ. sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ
mn112:19.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn112:19.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn112:19.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminīpaṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn112:20.1: tassa me evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha.
mn112:20.3: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn112:20.4: evaṃ kho me āvuso, jānato evaṃ passato imasmiñca saviññāṇake kāye bahiddhā ca sabbanimittesu ahiṅkāramamiṅkāramānānusayā samūhatāti.
mn112:21.1: tassa bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditabbaṃ anumoditabbaṃ.
mn112:21.2: sādhūti bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā evamassa vacanīyo:
mn112:21.4: ye mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ tādisaṃ brahmacāriṃ passāmā’ti.
mn112:21.6: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
